title.raw: Spring Bike Service Checklist for Commuters
title.rendered: Spring Bike Service Checklist for Commuters

content.rendered:
A bike that sat in the shed all winter needs about an hour of care before its first long ride. This checklist is the one we use in the workshop at Tidewater Cycle Works. You can do most of it at home with a rag, a pump and a set of hex keys.

Start with the tyres

Rubber dries out when it sits. Look along both sidewalls for small cracks, and check the tread for glass or flint that worked its way in last autumn. Pump each tyre to the pressure printed on the sidewall and leave the bike for ten minutes. If a tyre feels soft again, the tube has a slow leak and should be replaced before you ride.

How hard should they be?

Wider tyres run softer. A 40 mm commuter tyre is happy around 3.5 bar, while a 25 mm road tyre wants closer to 6. Our tyre pressure guide has a table for common sizes and rider weights.

Check the brakes

Squeeze each lever hard. It should stop well before it touches the handlebar. Then look at the pads. Rim brake pads have wear lines moulded into them, and disc pads need at least one millimetre of material. Pads are cheap. Rims and rotors are not.

Cables and hoses

Follow each cable from lever to brake and look for rust or fraying near the clamp bolt. Hydraulic hoses should be dry along their whole length. A damp patch near a fitting means a leak, and that is a job for a workshop.

Clean and oil the chain

Wipe the chain with a dry rag until the rag comes away mostly clean. Put one drop of oil on each roller, turn the cranks backwards a few times, then wipe off the extra. Oil on the outside of a chain only collects dirt. The Bike Repair Notes site has a clear set of repair articles if you want to go further and measure chain wear yourself.

When to bring it in

If the gears skip under load, a wheel wobbles between the brake pads, or anything creaks when you stand on the pedals, book a service and we will take a look. A spring service takes us about two days in March and closer to a week in May, so earlier is better.
